title: Serialization Length Bound
statement: Let $c$ be an effective machine code with canonizer and let $\alpha$ be a binary word. The length of the serialization of the machine decoded from $\alpha$ is at most the canonizer's time bound at input length $|\alpha|$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is an effective machine code with a canonizer that computes the serialization of the decoded machine within its specified time bound
replaced:
Let $c$ be an effective machine representation scheme and let $\alpha$ be a bit string.
If the scheme's canonizer computes the canonical serialization of the machine decoded
from each code within its specified time bound, then the length of the canonical
serialization of the machine decoded from $\alpha$ is at most the canonizer's time bound
at input length $|\alpha|$.
